name: singlet_velocity_gene_kinetics_velocity_estimation
title: Per-gene kinetics and RNA velocity
description: Fits a per-gene kinetic model to spliced and unspliced counts and writes per-gene rates and a per-cell velocity matrix. Needs spliced and unspliced layers and a kNN graph. The default scvelo_dynamical is the reference; velovi and velovae add posterior uncertainty, and scvelo_steady_state is the cheap equilibrium baseline. Do not use on labelled reads; latent time is a separate tool.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Kinetic method; scvelo_dynamical is the default and the reference.

min_shared_counts.description: Minimum shared spliced plus unspliced counts per gene before fitting.

n_top_genes.description: Highly variable genes passed to the kinetic fit.

n_neighbors.description: kNN size for first and second moment smoothing.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed; used by velovi and velovae only.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without fitting.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

scvelo.description: Options for the three scvelo_* methods; ignored by the learned methods.

max_iter.description: EM iterations for the dynamical method.

fit_scaling.description: Fit the per-gene unspliced and spliced scale ratio rho.

fit_steady_states.description: Allow steady-state states in the dynamical model.

fit_time.description: Fit per-cell time inside the dynamical model.

fit_offset.description: Fit an intercept in the steady-state regression.

quantiles.description: Percentile pair selecting extreme cells for steady-state initialisation.

velovi.description: Options for velovi; ignored by other methods.

n_samples.description: Posterior samples for velocity uncertainty; other training settings use library defaults.

velovae.description: Options for velovae; ignored by other methods.

n_samples.description: Posterior samples for velocity uncertainty; other training settings use library defaults.
